## About {#about}

Research Engineer in Health Data Science (PhD) and computational methodologist working at the interface of biostatistics, machine learning, and applied health data analytics. I hold a PhD in Biomedical Sciences from Aix-Marseille University (SESSTIM laboratory) on missing data and machine learning methods for survival analysis.

My work focuses on developing algorithms and statistical methodology for health data analysis, covering survival analysis, missing data imputation, and machine learning. I develop open-source R packages for survival analysis, missing data, and interpretable machine learning, and contribute as a consultant and trainer in biostatistics and health data science. Moroccan and French national, husband and father.

## Research {#research}

- **Survival machine learning**: Individualized survival prediction | neural survival models | RMST-based summaries, and trajectory phenotyping.
- **Missing data**: Evaluation of imputation strategies
- **Interpretable ML**: Explanation workflows aligned with clinical reasoning, including SHAP-style attributions, PDP/ICE/ALE, and stability diagnostics.
- **Agentic data science**: Autonomous agents that orchestrate analytical workflows for health research.

</div>
<div class="split-col">

## Consulting {#consulting}

I provide independent methodological and statistical consulting for health research teams, from study design through publication.

- Study design and analysis plan review
- Statistical methodology
- Evidence synthesis
- Machine learning prediction for health outcomes
- Custom R package and tool development

Engagements are scoped individually: short advisory sessions, analysis support on a specific study, or longer-term collaboration. [Get in touch →](#contact)

</div>

: {tbl-colwidths="[45,40,15]"}

*Outside working hours:* I organize **Methods in Health Data Science with R (MHDSR)**, an independent training pathway covering applied biostatistics, survival analysis, machine learning, and meta-analysis with R, delivered live to research teams and open cohorts:

- **BIOSTATR**: Applied Biostatistics with R (foundations)
- **ML4HOR**: Machine Learning for Health Outcomes with R (prediction)
- **METAR**: Conducting Meta-Analysis with R (evidence synthesis)

Visit [mhdsr.com](https://mhdsr.com) for details, or [get in touch →](#contact) for more information.
